investment_policy_en:
The fund uses a flexible, blended investment strategy founded on a bottom-up approach. A thorough investigation of each company and its management followed by a fair valuation is at the core of the selection process. The fund managers prefer longer investment Horizons in order to benefit from revaluation processes.

At least 75% of assets are invested in eurozone companies with sound fundamentals, including those with large market capitalisation, as well as small-cap and mid-cap companies.

The sub-fund’s investment target is to outperform the Benchmark (Sales Prospectus „8.SPECIFIC INFORMATION ON THE BENCHMARK“).
